lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p31 - Talk about the pictures. Make predictions.

details: Talk about the pictures reviews the target language and structures from the unit and engages students in the story before they’ve listened to it by asking them to predict what happens.
Look for accurate identification and correct pronunciation of the target language, and predictions relevant to the topic.

Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs
